summary: Frontend-only bug fix verification for GPS shift stopShift error ('_LocationEventEmitter.LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription is not a function'). PASSED end-to-end. Completed onboarding (country AU/NSW -> worktype-delivery -> platform-Uber -> ownership-own -> skip recurring), reached Trips tab (business-use % gauge rendered correctly), tapped gps-start with browser geolocation granted, simulated movement across 5 coordinates around Sydney (~4.3s apart to respect watchPositionAsync timeInterval:4000), tracker accumulated 3.06 km, then tapped gps-stop. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors, no red-box appeared, and the 'removeSubscription is not a function' signature was NOT present anywhere. The Business/Personal classification card rendered as expected showing '3.06 km drive'. Tapped gps-tag-business — the trip saved via POST /api/trips, success toast '3.06 km logged as business' surfaced, and it appears in History with a green 'Business' badge and '· GPS' source marker. Regression check: trips-add opens the Add Trip entry screen with distance/type/date/note/save fields wired correctly; business-use gauge still renders. Only lingering issue is the same non-blocking RN Web warning already flagged in iteration_1 ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.').

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproducing GPS distance on the web preview requires: (1) context.grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin=EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL); (2) context.set_geolocation({...}) BEFORE tapping gps-start to set an initial fix; (3) after tapping gps-start, call set_geolocation again with new coords and wait >=4200ms per step (watchPositionAsync timeInterval is 4000ms and distanceInterval 20m — spread coords ~200-400m apart around a real city like Sydney -33.87,151.21). Five coord updates were enough to accumulate ~3 km. Onboarding sequence testIDs: onboarding-next, worktype-delivery, platform-Uber (case-sensitive), ownership-own, then final onboarding-next to skip recurring. GPS testIDs: gps-start, gps-stop, gps-tag-business, gps-tag-personal.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: subRef.current?.remove() called into expo-location's web shim, which internally invokes LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription — a helper that was removed in React Native 0.65+ (subscriptions now expose .remove() directly on themselves, not via the emitter). On native this path never fires because expo-location has a real subscription object; on web the shim still references the removed emitter API, so calling remove() throws 'LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription is not a function'. Fix wraps the call in try/catch and continues to null subRef and flip tracking off. Verified: after the fix, tapping End drive on the web preview shows no error, transitions cleanly to the classify prompt (or 'No distance recorded' toast when km<=0), and the shift can be saved as Business/Personal successfully.
